format: C++/Objective-C (Metal shaders and CUDA-like code for MPS)
description: This source file contains implementation of various sparse tensor operations optimized for Apple Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) backend in PyTorch. It includes functions for sparse tensor arithmetic, masking, multiplication, intersection, and softmax operations specifically tailored for MPS tensors on Apple hardware.
